last.verdict: Cloudflare's growth sped up to 39% and its Q4 revenue forecast landed far above analyst expectations, though gross margin keeps shrinking.

takeaways.label: Growth accelerating
takeaways.text: Revenue rose 39% to $782.5M, up from 36% last quarter and the fastest in nearly four years, beating the roughly $740M analysts expected. Annualized revenue passed $3B.

takeaways.label: Forecast well above estimates
takeaways.text: Q4 revenue is guided to $845–846M versus about $798M expected. Full-year guidance rose to about $2.963B from $2.864–2.870B in August.

takeaways.label: Margin squeeze
takeaways.text: Gross margin (non-GAAP) fell to 72.4% from 75.3% a year ago, and 73.1% last quarter. Operating margin still rose to 17.5% from 15.3%.

takeaways.label: Cash flow lags
takeaways.text: Free cash flow was $82M, or 10% of revenue, versus 13% a year ago. Capital spending jumped to 16% of revenue from 15%.

history.verdict: Accelerating growth and a raised full-year outlook won buyers, though much of the after-hours pop faded.

reasons.label: Growth sped up
reasons.text: Revenue rose 36% from a year earlier, up from 34% last quarter, beating expectations.

reasons.label: Margins and one-time costs
reasons.text: Gross margin fell to 73.1% from 76.3%; a $150.7M restructuring charge weighed on results.
